The 10-Q reveals eight material SIFI signals: (1) $53.9B goodwill + $4.9B IPR&D with multi-year completion risk; (2) $30.4B new debt across three tranches (2-, 3-, 5-year maturities) at floating SOFR rates; (3) $8.25B assumed VMware notes with repurchase rights on change-of-control or rating downgrade (101% make-whole); (4) $15.5B contract liabilities (up from $2.8B pre-acquisition), 39% termination-for-convenience; (5) $27.7B remaining performance obligations, only 44% firm within 12 months; (6) $712M restructuring charges in Q1 alone, completion expected by end FY2025; (7) pending securities litigation over VMware's pre-acquisition backlog disclosures; (8) $3.8B divestiture of EUC business (signed Feb 2024, closing TBD).
